owner_decision.statement: milo_forage_seeds_3q_r002_candidate.png is still lacking, milo_inspect_log_3q_r002_candidate.png passed, and milo_walk_screen_right_lightstep_3q_opposite_contact_r002_candidate.png passed as well as milo_walk_screen_right_lightstep_3q_passing_step_r002_candidate.png. so now we jsut need to tweak milo forage seeds

creation.prompt: Create one corrected transparent full-body Milo pose candidate. Reference 1 is canonical identity; reference 2 is the OWNER'S PRIMARY HEAD-TO-BODY PROPORTION TARGET (berry reach), reference 3 is a compatible body/proportion comparison, and reference 4 is the rejected action candidate being replaced. Correct its proportions rather than recreating its oversized-head impression. Use the berry reference's anatomical skull-to-torso, ears-to-torso, shoulder-to-hip and torso-to-leg relationships; exclude its raised arm when judging body length. Preserve that small rounded head relative to a readable lean upright torso, not a huge head above a compact stump. Preserve canonical green eyes, muzzle, grey felt wool, cream chest inset, short sturdy limbs and orange tail. Do not solve this by zooming out, scaling the whole mouse, cropping, thinning the torso further or lengthening limbs unnaturally: head and torso must remain proportionate within one character. Keep three-quarter facing screen-right with restrained perspective; no closer-to-camera enlarged head. Use a modest knee bend and forward torso lean; keep both hands forward at low-log-rim height, feet planted. Keep the full-length lean ribcage visible between shoulders and hips. Avoid a large face projecting toward the viewer. Do not inflate the skull to make the reaction readable. Do not render the log. Mouth closed with no teeth; full ears, hands, feet and entire tail comfortably inside frame. Neutral studio light. Truly transparent background, no ground plate, cast ground shadow, scenery, props, text, watermark or extra mouse. One pose only.
